title: Worksheet 8: Hardware vs. Software
directions: Read the paragraph below carefully. Then answer all questions using ONLY the information in the paragraph. Circle the letter of the best answer.
paragraph: Every computer system is made up of two basic categories: hardware and software. Hardware refers to the physical parts of a computer that you can actually touch, such as the keyboard, mouse, monitor, hard drive, and the internal circuit boards. If you could open up a computer and hold a piece in your hand, it is hardware. Software, on the other hand, refers to the programs and instructions that tell the hardware what to do. Software cannot be physically touched; it exists as code stored on the hardware. For example, a word processing program, a web browser, and a video game are all examples of software. Hardware and software depend on each other to make a computer useful: hardware without software has no instructions to follow, and software without hardware has no physical machine to run on.

questions.correct: The physical parts of a computer you can touch
